_comment: Served straight from Vercel at /android-latest.json. The APK's native Updater reads it (via the same-origin fetch in src/lib/appUpdate.ts) and compares versionCode for its own applicationId. The APK files are on the android-apps GitHub release (fixed URLs, see src/lib/apkHosting.ts): upload a new build there before bumping versionCode here. Keep versionCode in sync with android/app/build.gradle. See docs/APP_UPDATES.md.

com.clickgroup.pos.notes: Fixes the app closing right after login (1.5 / 1.5.1). Faster launch, branded splash screen, native Back button, status bar matches the app, and an offline screen that reconnects by itself.
